title: Chess, But I Lose Half My Time Every Move
summary: Chess vs Martin where the player's clock halves after every move he makes: it starts huge (~2 hours, 1:59:26 seen) and collapses toward 0 (thumbnail 10:00.00 -> 00:00.05).
rules: Standard chess vs Martin (250); player is White.
After each player move, the player's remaining time is cut in half (thumbnail implies start 10:00; frame shows a 1:59:26 clock, so the starting time may be larger in some games — not verified).
Player loses on time when the clock reaches 0; Martin's clock is normal.
win_condition: Checkmate Martin before your clock runs out.

events: On each player move: player clock = clock / 2
